name: 5 shots on the beep (par 5.0s)
notes: Random delay, beep, 5 shots. Striker pistol: splits include rack time.

name: 5-dot sequence (par 8s)
notes: Each shot must hit the next dot in order.

name: Clay trio, shotgun (par 4s)
notes: Shotgun mode forced on; uses the target's spread.

name: IDPA-style familiarization course (8 stages)
notes: Time + points down. Swap the printed target before each stage; the app checks the target ID. Score = raw time + PD x1s + PE x3s + HNT x5s. Lower is better.

stages.name: 1. Warm-up (practice face)
stages.brief: 3 shots to the dark body -0 circle. Learn the zones.

stages.name: 2. Basic threat
stages.brief: From the beep: 2 to the body -0.

stages.name: 3. Head shots
stages.brief: 2 to the head -0 circle; rest of the head box is -1.

stages.name: 4. Hard cover: left
stages.brief: Left half is behind hard cover. 2 on the exposed -0.

stages.name: 5. Hard cover: lower
stages.brief: Lower body covered. 2 on the upper -0 or head.

stages.name: 6. Hard cover: diagonal
stages.brief: Diagonal cover. 2 on the exposed -0 edge.

stages.name: 7. Threat + non-threat
stages.brief: 2 on the RIGHT threat only. Hands = non-threat (+5 s).

stages.name: 8. Multiple threats
stages.brief: 2 each on T1, T2, T3 in order. Out of order = PE.

name: IDPA-style random calls (letter landscape)
notes: Targets are called in random order (spoken + shown). Shoot only the called threats with the required shots; T5 Mozambique = 2 body then 1 head. T6 / front of T8 are non-threats (+5 s). Wrong order or Mozambique part = PE +3 s. Each PD = +1 s, miss = 5 PD.

name: Shoot / don't-shoot: threat vs compliant (tabloid 11x17)
notes: At the beep 4 targets are called: 'GUN' = threat, shoot it 2x; 'HANDS UP' = compliant: do NOT shoot, give a verbal command ('Drop it!', 'Show me your hands!', 'Police, don't move!') within 3 s. Each hit on a compliant target = +5 s; each compliant target without a command in time = +3 s. Mic must be on. Only command phrases are heard while live.
